Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their recovery as lower crude prices and global yields boosted market sentiment. Ten key factors are expected to influence the upcoming stock market action.

Markets.title: SME IPO: Liqvd Digital India issue to open on Sep 23; price band fixed at Rs 51-54
Markets.summary: Liqvd Digital India's Rs 39-crore SME initial public offering will open for subscription from September 23 to September 25 with a price band of Rs 51 to Rs 54 per share. The company will list its shares on the BSE SME platform and use the proceeds to acquire a video content production hub.

Markets.title: Gold likely to stay range-bound next week as dollar, West Asia tensions guide market: Analysts
Markets.summary: Analysts expect gold prices to remain range-bound next week, driven by currency fluctuations and West Asian geopolitical tensions. Investors will closely monitor upcoming mid-month manufacturing and services PMI readings from major economies for market direction.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar, Medanta among 5 stock recommendations for Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their recovery as softer crude prices and global yields improved investor risk appetite. Analysts have recommended five stocks with bullish technical setups for Monday, including ACME Solar, Medanta, Tilaknagar Industries, Uno Minda, and PWL.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | India may see 50 bps of rate hikes in 2026 as Fed tightens: Garima Kapoor
Markets.summary: Elara Securities economist Garima Kapoor predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by 25 to 50 basis points in 2026. This monetary tightening is expected as narrower India-US bond yield differentials and a stronger US dollar pressure foreign portfolio investor flows.

Markets.title: Rs 23,000 crore outflows! Is the September FII rout indicating a worse end to 2026?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors pulled over Rs 23,000 crore from Indian equities between September 1 and September 19 due to rising crude prices, US bond yields, and geopolitical risks. Domestic institutional investors are currently helping cushion the market against this heavy foreign selling pressure.

Geo-Political.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Merz described recent state election results as a disaster after exit polls revealed damaging losses for his centre-right CDU party in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Despite these setbacks, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

Geo-Political.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, involving 450 drones intercepted overnight, according to the city's mayor. The barrage resulted in two deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
Geo-Political.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed past mistakes during his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour. Macklemore had been dropped following pro-Palestinian remarks made on stage, which led to Sheeran's comments regarding Israel and Gaza.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump announced that a planned triumphal arch will be converted into a military complex equipped with drones and snipers. He stated that these updated design changes were made at the request of the US military for national security purposes.

Geo-Political.title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
Geo-Political.summary: An 82-year-old man has died following a physical fight with a 76-year-old man over a sunlounger on a beach in Greece. The violent confrontation caused widespread chaos and loud screaming that carried across the entire beach.

Geo-Political.title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
Geo-Political.summary: Aleema Khanum, the sister of Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan, has been arrested. She is accused of mobilizing her brother's supporters in preparation for nationwide protests.

AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result to a user's prompt without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: China drives India’s BRICS export surge to $19.9 billion; shipments to Japan, Italy, S Korea also gain
Data & Insights.summary: India's exports to BRICS nations surged 34% from April to August 2026, led by a 39% increase in shipments to China. During the same period, exports to Japan rose 43%, driven largely by energy products and electronics.

Data & Insights.title: Why does India need to save more?
Data & Insights.summary: India needs a higher gross domestic savings rate to sustain 7-8% economic growth. This increased saving is required to fund ongoing investments in infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, technology, housing, and human capital.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi Arabia exits mBridge: Can China-led platform still challenge US dollar, become global cross-border payment system?
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia quietly exited the China-led mBridge digital currency project in 2025 as originally planned. Despite this withdrawal, the platform continues to expand its efforts to enable faster cross-border payments and reduce reliance on the US dollar and SWIFT.

Data & Insights.title: Food prices stable as pulses, cereals output rises; sugar rates ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's pulses production reached a record 27.4 million tonnes in 2025-26, while cereals output rose by about 5% to 349.1 million tonnes. This increased production helped stabilize food prices and ease sugar rates.

Data & Insights.title: Industry has to follow the consumer, says FSSAI chief on food-safety push
Data & Insights.summary: The FSSAI chief stated that the food industry must adapt to changing consumer demands while the agency increases its safety oversight. This expanded scrutiny specifically targets e-commerce platforms, product labelling, and school food safety.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Credit growth, flash PMI, Fed signals
Data & Insights.summary: This article previews the major economic data releases and market events for the upcoming week. It highlights key focus areas, including credit growth figures, flash PMI data, and signals from the Federal Reserve.

India.title: Analysis: Fewer Fires, Same Fog: Punjab's Stubble Politics Before 2027 Polls
India.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Punjab elections, farmers are expected to continue burning stubble to clear their fields. The administration will likely refrain from issuing fines to avoid political backlash during the election year.

India.title: Tata Trusts Against Listing, Diverted Attention: Harish Salve To NDTV
India.summary: Harish Salve stated on NDTV that Tata Trusts opposes listing the $270 billion empire because it would divert their control. He noted that the government's requirement for them to list forces a change in how the trust operates.

India.title: Punjab Man Consumes Poison Over Drug Inaction, Sparks Political Row
India.summary: A man in Punjab's Namol village consumed poison after police and local authorities allegedly failed to act on his complaints about drug peddling. His suicide attempt has triggered a political controversy in the state.

India.title: '25,000 CCTVs, 0 Arrests': Faridabad Man Seeks Answers After Father's Death
India.summary: Lakshmi Narayan Jhanwar was killed in a hit-and-run car accident in Faridabad on August 27. Despite the area having 25,000 CCTV cameras, police have not made any arrests in the case.

India.title: On The Run For 24 Years, Rajasthan Man Arrested From Gujarat For Murder
India.summary: A Rajasthan man was arrested in Gujarat for a murder he committed 24 years ago. To avoid capture, he spent over two decades constantly moving, hiding his identity, and working daily-wage jobs.

India.title: Woman Entrepreneur's 'Guest House Invite' Charge Against Revanth Reddy's Aide
India.summary: Hyderabad-based entrepreneur K Shobha Reddy alleged on X that an aide of Chief Minister Revanth Reddy charged her to secure a guest house invitation. She directed her accusation at the Chief Minister while detailing the incident involving Mithuna Ads.

General.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
General.summary: German Chancellor Merz described his centre-right CDU party's losses in the Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state elections as a disaster. Despite the damaging exit poll results, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

General.title: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
General.summary: Earl Spencer defended claims he made about the King during an interview with BBC journalist Laura Kuenssberg. The interview took place ahead of the publication of his new book about his late sister, Diana, Princess of Wales.

General.title: Specialist courts for rape cases to be rolled out across England and Wales
General.summary: Specialist courts for rape cases will be introduced across England and Wales. The government's funding will allow victims to view proceedings remotely and give evidence via video link from a separate room.

General.title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
General.summary: The National Association of Head Teachers in England is calling for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections. The union argues that the current inspection process poses a serious health risk and potential "risk to life" for school leaders.

General.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
General.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, involving approximately 450 drones intercepted overnight by air defenses. The massive barrage resulted in two fatalities in the Russian capital.

General.title: Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting
General.summary: Andy Burnham praised a new Greenland agreement before his anticipated first meeting with Donald Trump. Meanwhile, Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey dismissed the deal as a pretend victory for Trump.
